name: lane-pace
description: Paces Claude Code subagents: a live-lane cap under a pace word, one judgment seat allowed the top model, a model ladder for nested spawns, and an optional brief-size check before a lane starts

paceFile.title: Pace file
paceFile.description: File holding the pace word, quiet, wide, or a word the paces option names. Relative paths read under the session root. Missing reads wide, so nothing is capped until the file says quiet.

quietCap.title: Quiet cap
quietCap.description: Live subagents allowed at once under pace quiet. Zero refuses every spawn under quiet.

paces.title: Pace words
paces.description: More pace words, each with its own cap, as a space list of word=cap pairs such as calm=1 busy=4. A word the list does not name gets its smallest cap. wide is always uncapped and cannot be listed, and quiet keeps the quiet cap unless you list it. Empty leaves quiet as the one capped word.

seatAgent.title: Judgment seat agent
seatAgent.description: The one subagent type allowed to run on the seat model. Empty turns the seat rule off.

seatModel.title: Judgment seat model
seatModel.description: The model family refused to every subagent but the judgment seat.

agentsDir.title: Agents folder
agentsDir.description: Folder of project agent files whose model: pin the mod reads. ~/.claude/agents is read after it.

ladder.title: Model ladder
ladder.description: Opt-in. Refuse a nested spawn unless it runs one tier below its parent, Haiku to Haiku allowed.

briefScript.title: Brief-size script
briefScript.description: Bash script run on each lane brief a spawn prompt names. Exit 1 refuses, exit 2 refuses as unparsed. Empty turns the check off.

briefTimeoutMs.title: Brief-size timeout
briefTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds the brief-size script may run before the check fails open.

bundleDir.title: Bundle folder
bundleDir.description: Folder holding the numbered bundle folders that lane briefs sit in.

bundlePrefix.title: Bundle prefix
bundlePrefix.description: Prefix of a bundle folder, as in CC-148. Matched in any case, spelled this way on disk.

briefPattern.title: Brief pattern
briefPattern.description: A regular expression that replaces the brief path pattern built from the bundle prefix. Empty keeps the built one.
